intro.title: Electricity customer onboarding, end to end
intro.text: A household with solar panels joins at the pace of life: AI agents, people and back-office systems, every step written to the record as it happens. Then seven more customers, eight times faster, and the measures computed from the same record.
points: The journey of each customer, live

outro.title: Off the shelf, and plug and play
outro.text: Replace the reference adapters with your own systems, set the secrets, enable the policy and keep the journals. Every scenario runs to its end in the TypeScript and Python SDKs.
points: Eight scenarios, tested in both SDKs

moments.caption: The documents agent reads every document through the extraction service, and checks it against the application.
Credit, identity and metering point are checked side by side; the eligibility table accepts Tomás.
Hana resolved the file, so she may not approve the export too: separation of duties.
The supply starts, and the journey reaches its goal: Tomás is an active customer.

steps.caption: A guardrail withholds the commissioning report: it carries instructions hidden for the reviewing system.
The agent is not sure enough: its outcome contract hands the documents to a person.

Every number opens the customers behind it, and from each the journey view.
